title: Massachusetts oral Schedule III through V follow-up request
rule_summary: For an oral Schedule III through V prescription issued under the out-of-state pathway, the pharmacist records requesting a written prescription within seven days or the shorter federal period.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply oral follow-up requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Massachusetts oral Schedule III through V follow-up request

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing oral follow-up with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
